description.en: The newly proposed FLUS model is an integrated model for multi-type land use scenario simulations by coupling human and natural effects. At the same time, the spatial simulation module of the FLUS model was made into GUI software named GeoSOS-FLUS . The GeoSOS-FLUS was developed as an extension of the previous GeoSOS software to facilitate the multiple land use change simulations. The software provides a multiple CA allocation model for simulating land use change and scenario analysis.
